parking.note: General admission parking is included with your ticket. For easier entry and exit, consider upgrading to Reserved Parking, Star Parking, or Star Parking Plus. Arrive early to avoid heavy traffic and long wait times.

rideshare.note: Rideshare drivers may drop you off, but the venue cannot guarantee return pickup. Arrange your return transportation before the show.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The accessible entrance is at the main gate, and staffed accessibility tables are at the main entrance and at the Guest Service booth to the right of the main stage. Accessible parking is outside the main gates through Gate B and requires an accessible placard with its owner present. A special services vehicle can take one disabled guest and one companion from the campground to the amphitheatre.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted at The Gorge except on selected festival events.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Entry is mobile only: download your tickets to your phone in the Live Nation app before you go, since tickets are not emailed or printable. If a ticket needs to be reprinted during the event, the box office can do it for a fee. For upgrades or exchanges, contact the Box Office at 206.607.3440.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gates usually open 90 minutes before show time, and parking lots generally open two hours before gate time. Expect to wait 2 to 4 hours to get into the venue, and check your event page or the Know Before You Go page for exact times.
